issues.description: The problem statement specifies an initializer init(books: [Book]) for Bookstore (problem_statement.md lines 9-12), but the reference implementation defines init(books: [Book], valid: Bool) in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift. This extra parameter in the solution contradicts the required initializer signature and will prevent code that expects init(books:) (including the solution's own call at assembleBookstore) from compiling, confusing students about the correct constructor to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bookstore initializer signature consistent with the problem statement by removing the extra parameter from the solution: change init(books: [Book], valid: Bool) to init(books: [Book]). Alternatively, if the extra parameter is intended, update the problem statement and all calls to use init(books: [Book], valid: Bool) or provide a default value for the extra parameter (e.g. valid: Bool = true) so calls using only books remain valid.
